sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows insulin glulisine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 268 syringes at 10.1 per day for 26.6 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 277 syringes at 12.1 per day for 23 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 60 syringes at 2.3 per day for 25.6 days on hand.
The product label identifies Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH (FEI 3003195501) as the manufacturing plant for NDC 00088250205.
FDA inspection records for that plant show a VAI classification on 2022-03-25 and an OAI classification on 2010-09-16 with a Warning Letter issued 2011-02-08.
Check current supplier allocation status and confirm whether any recent FDA actions affect the registered plant.
